rules.why: the bright pixels sit on the palette's roles
a hue budget: at most four hue families plus white in a frame
outside ripples and light pools the floor stays dark
light comes from emitters; the dark stays dark
white is earned: at most 2% clipped outside impact frames
a dense clump of one type reads as individuals, not a blob
